title: Programmatic video: cards, clips and a fading scene

source.html:
CARDS KEEP THEIR LOOK

A card with a look

Background, border, radius and shadow become a clip beneath the text.

Second card

It fades and slides with the scene, and every word stays editable.

ONE CLIP THAT CUTS, ONE THAT DOES NOT

Revealed through a clip
Fits insideits own box
